description: Queue AI translation for selected template locales. Omit `locales` to sync every enabled non-primary locale. This works even when automatic on-save localization is disabled. By default it also retranslates locales someone edited; set `skipEdited` to keep those and get them back in `skippedLocales`.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

locales.description: Optional enabled non-primary locale codes to sync. Omit to sync all enabled non-primary locales.

skipEdited.description: Keep translations someone edited (set via set_template_localization or the dashboard) instead of retranslating them. Defaults to false.

templateId.description: Template ID, transactional email ID, or slug.

name: sync_template_localizations

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `sync_template_localizations` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

queuedLocales.description: Locale codes queued for AI translation.

queuedVariantCount.description: Number of localized variants queued for translation.

skippedLocales.description: Locale codes kept because someone edited them (only with skipEdited).

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
